reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; checked cap, covered hair, brows, absence of added facial hair, one mouth, eyewear, uniform and collar insignia, pose, crop, lighting, collar fit, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The field-gray/olive peaked cap, gold front insignia, gold visor decoration and dark eyebrows remain; covered hair is not replaced with extra visible hair. The face has a smooth chin and no added moustache or beard, one serious closed mouth and no spectacles. The nearly frontal capped head, gaze slightly toward viewer left, squared shoulders, chest-up crop and frontal light moderated by the cap-brim shadow are retained. The olive/field-gray uniform keeps two red collar patches with gold details, light-gray shirt opening and one dark tie. The shirt and collar sit naturally around a short broad neck immediately beneath the rounded chin, with no long yellow column, narrow pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha inspection; 252-254 values were not treated as automatic defects and no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap and collar insignia shapes are unreadable at 65x67; only their visible gold/red forms and placements were compared, without claiming exact microscopic symbols. Note marks remain indistinct source-scale groups rather than readable text.
